components.name: CmsLegalPage
components.summary: Renders typed Contentful or repository legal-page sections with paragraphs and optional bullet inputs.
components.notes: Contentful owns only editable presentation; the route keeps its repository fallback when no complete CMS page is available.

components.name: DocTemplateCover
components.summary: Displays one cropped cover from the shared six-image Docs template atlas.
components.notes: Uses one atlas asset with CSS background positioning; decorative artwork is hidden from accessibility APIs.

components.name: PageLoading
components.summary: Theme-aware full-page background loader with localized accessible status and optional branding.
components.notes: Replaces the authenticated shell skeleton, duplicate Workspace route spinner, and command-center Convex-auth skeleton with one shared loading boundary.

components.name: PipelineBoard
components.summary: Generic drag/drop column board. Takes items + stages, emits move/create/delete callbacks. 165-line orchestrator (was 709) composed of 11 deep puzzle pieces.
components.notes: Stateless — caller owns data fetching and mutation logic. Re-exported from components/shared/view-system. Composed of: CardDefault, CardFooterActions, ColumnHeader (StageBar + CountBadge + NewBadge + PopoverMenu), InlineNewCard, useSortableBoard, stage-color.

components.name: PopoverMenu
components.summary: Generic kebab / more-options dropdown menu. Outside-click + Escape close. Destructive items get danger styling.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx:36-93. Originally a private component, now shareable. Replaces 6+ inlined kebab menus across the workspace (planned).

components.name: CardDefault
components.summary: Default card render for the pipeline board. Composed of CardFooterActions + PopoverMenu. Header/body/footer slot rendering.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx DefaultCard. 192 lines, was 215 inline.

components.name: CardFooterActions
components.summary: Bottom action row inside a pipeline card. Renders a button per CardAction, or a default 'View' button.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx DefaultCard footer.

components.name: ColumnHeader
components.summary: Column header for a pipeline stage. Composed of StageBar + editable title + CountBadge + NewBadge + add button + PopoverMenu kebab.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx column header block. Owns the in-place edit state for the column title.

components.name: CountBadge
components.summary: Count pill for a pipeline column. Color-tinted background + text. Uses badgeBgFor() color math.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx column header count pill.

components.name: NewBadge
components.summary: 'New' gradient badge for newly-added columns. Pulse animation.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx column header new badge.

components.name: StageBar
components.summary: Top color bar of a pipeline column. 1-line visual, parameterized by color.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx column header top bar.

components.name: InlineNewCard
components.summary: Inline create form for a pipeline card. Title + optional contact + save/cancel. Enter to commit, Escape to cancel.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx. Replaces 6+ inlined inline-create forms across the workspace (planned).

components.name: useSortableBoard
components.summary: SortableJS lifecycle hook for a kanban board. Includes the DOM-revert workaround that prevents the 'removeChild' race when SortableJS moves a node before React re-renders.
components.notes: Extracted from pipeline-board.tsx. The DOM-revert logic at lines 477-495 of the original is preserved byte-for-byte — drag-between-stages still works without console errors.

components.name: PipelineStageIndicator
components.summary: Multi-stage progress indicator showing where an entity is in a pipeline. Three variants: dots (table cells), strip (detail headers), breadcrumb (card-internal). User-flagged missing puzzle.
components.notes: NEW puzzle piece. Adopted in deal-board (column header strip) and client-list-item (row dots). Recommended further adopters: client-table-view.tsx, notion-client-table.tsx, pipeline-stages-settings.tsx.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: Horizontal progress bar. value/max with size variants (xs/sm/md/lg), optional color, optional label.
components.notes: NEW puzzle piece. Replaces 9+ inlined progress bar copies across the workspace (planned).

components.name: WidgetShell
components.summary: Wrapper for a widget in the widget grid. Drag handle, rename input, resize controls, kebab menu (now via PopoverMenu).
components.notes: Extracted from widget-grid.tsx:285-438. 143 lines, was 153 inline. Kebab menu reuses PopoverMenu.

components.name: WidgetGrid
components.summary: Resizable card grid. Each widget has configurable size and content slot.
components.notes: Caller controls widget content via renderWidget slot.

components.name: TokenBar
components.summary: Horizontal token bar with '+' add trigger. Supports searchable categorized add modal.
components.notes: Composed with AddTokenModal for the add flow.

components.name: TiptapDocumentEditor
components.summary: Chrome-free Tiptap HTML editor with a caret-anchored slash palette, active-line plus control, selection formatting, and durable image paste/drop uploads.
components.notes: Used by task workspaces through WorkOsDocEditor's editorEngine option while preserving the existing HTML persistence contract. No permanent block handles or insertion chrome.

components.name: YooptaRichTextEditor
components.summary: Yoopta rich text editor with HTML in/out, document/card tooling, and a chrome-free composer variant for compact chat input.
components.notes: Replaces Tiptap editor surfaces while preserving existing HTML persistence contracts. The composer variant removes document borders, focus rings, and block controls without changing document and card variants.

components.name: AddTokenModal
components.summary: Searchable categorized modal for adding tokens via TokenBar.
components.notes: Used alongside TokenBar.

components.name: ModulePanel
components.summary: Slide-in panel with header, body, footer sections. Supports tabs, fullscreen, close button.
components.notes: Generic right-side detail panel pattern. Width configurable.

components.name: EntityHeader
components.summary: Entity header bar with back button, title, description, and action buttons.
components.notes: Used for detail page headers across entity domains.

components.name: AppPageShell
components.summary: Standard page layout container with header, toolbar, and content areas.
components.notes: Part of the AppLayoutKit family of layout primitives.

components.name: AppDataTable
components.summary: Standard data table with columns, sorting, and action slots.
components.notes: Defined in app-layout-kit alongside other App* primitives.

components.name: ViewSwitcher
components.summary: Tab-style view selector for switching between board/list/table/calendar views.
components.notes: Replaced old workspace-tab-switcher pattern.

components.name: PageShell
components.summary: Top-level page wrapper with consistent padding and max-width.
components.notes: Basic layout wrapper — not to be confused with AppPageShell which includes header/toolbar.

components.name: PageToolbar
components.summary: Horizontal toolbar with action buttons and filters.
components.notes: Flexible toolbar for page-level actions.

components.name: InlineCustomFieldCreator
components.summary: Inline record-aware custom field definition dialog with type, options, requirement, and view visibility configuration.
components.notes: Creates reusable field definitions at the record editor without redirecting to organization settings. Values remain record-specific through CustomFieldRenderer.

components.name: InfiniteScrollSentinel
components.summary: Intersection observer trigger for infinite scroll pagination.
components.notes: Lightweight — only renders a sentinel div.

components.name: SharePopover
components.summary: Popover for sharing entities with permission selection.
components.notes: Uses the popover UI primitive.

components.name: BadgeSelect
components.summary: Dropdown trigger styled as a badge. Shows current selection inline.
components.notes: Used for status/priority badge selectors.

components.name: RecordModal
components.summary: Generic modal for viewing/editing a single record.
components.notes: Resizable record editor shell. Callers own form state, validation, and writes; optional dimensions preserve the shared defaults while allowing dense record forms to request a larger canvas.

components.name: AddMenu
components.summary: Dropdown menu for creating new entities (projects, spaces, etc.).
components.notes: Gated by capability checks.

components.name: CustomFieldRenderer
components.summary: Renders a custom field value based on its type definition (text, number, date, select, etc.).
components.notes: Reused across entity detail pages.

components.name: ReviewInput
components.summary: Rating/review input with star picker and text input.
components.notes: Includes StarRatingPicker sub-component.

components.name: WorkOsDocEditor
components.summary: Document editor with metadata fields (title, description, meta fields) and mention support.
components.notes: Heavier component — includes rich text editing.

components.name: SidebarIndexPanel
components.summary: Workspace launcher sidebar panel: current workspace/space context plus navigation to Overview, Spaces, All tasks, My tasks, and Custom widgets.
components.notes: Renamed role from 'Home' to 'Workspace' launcher.

components.name: SidebarPanelLayout
components.summary: Shared secondary-panel shell with title actions, mode switch, optional header/footer, and configurable scrollable body spacing.
components.notes: Consistent shell for all secondary sidebar panels. bodyClassName lets dense panels avoid nested padding without duplicating the shell.

components.name: SidebarWorkspaceSwitcher
components.summary: Rail-top workspace avatar with dropdown for switching organizations and creating/joining workspaces.
components.notes: Self-contained; consumes auth session and organization list.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button with variants (primary, secondary, ghost, outline, destructive) and sizes.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive. Used everywhere.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal dialog with overlay, title, description, and close button.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: Dropdown menu with items, separators, sub-menus, and checkboxes.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Popover with trigger and content that floats above the page.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: Slide-in panel from left/right/bottom with overlay.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Tab navigation with content panels.
components.notes: Core shadcn/ui primitive.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Toast notification with variants (default, destructive) and auto-dismiss.
components.notes: Used via useToast hook for user feedback.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Loading placeholder with shimmer animation.
components.notes: Used for loading states.

components.name: ColorDot
components.summary: Small color circle indicator. 4 sizes (xs/sm/md/lg), optional ring, optional label. Generalized from DepartmentDot.
components.notes: Replaces 16+ inlined `h-2 w-2 rounded-full` copies across the workspace (planned).

components.name: ColorSwatch
components.summary: Selectable color circle button. Radio-style with selected/unselected states. Used by color pickers.
components.notes: Replaces 4 inlined color-swatch buttons in pipeline-stages-settings, space-create-form, space-settings (planned).

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Generic empty state placeholder. icon + title + description + optional action/children. Three sizes (sm/md/lg).
components.notes: Promoted from the workspace's EmptyWorkspace with a size prop. Replaces 12+ inlined `rounded-xl border border-dashed` empty states in clients/projects detail tabs (planned).

components.name: FilterChip
components.summary: Clickable filter chip with active/inactive states. Three sizes. FilterChipBar is the row-of-chips variant.
components.notes: Replaces inlined filter trigger patterns such as client filters and saved-view selectors.

components.name: LegendItem
components.summary: Color dot + label + value trio for chart legends. Two sizes.
components.notes: Replaces 6+ inlined legend rows in project-status-widget, assignee-widget, workload-chart-widget, integration-app-details, workspace-widgets (planned).

components.name: ListRow
components.summary: Clickable row with leading slot + title + subtitle + meta + trailing slot. Three variants (default/compact/card).
components.notes: Workspace-flavored variant of the existing ListItem* family (which uses different theme tokens). Replaces 10+ inlined row patterns in workspace-widgets, recent-projects-widget, space-switcher, task-grouped-list, integrations-overview (planned).

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: Status / tone pill. Five tones (success/warning/danger/info/neutral) × three variants (soft/solid/outline). Two sizes. Unified from 3 partials.
components.notes: Centralizes status tone and label presentation used by record tables and workspace views.

components.name: TagChip
components.summary: Rounded tag pill. 8 tones (gray/blue/green/amber/red/purple/pink/cyan) + custom color override + optional removable button. Two sizes.
components.notes: Replaces 12+ inlined tag-pill patterns in task-table-widget, task-list-view, notion-client-table, calendar-tab, doc-grid-view, etc. (planned). Complements (does not replace) the existing TokenBar and EditableTags which serve different surfaces.

components.name: EditableTitle
components.summary: Click-to-edit title (sibling of EditableText). 4 sizes, 3 trigger modes (doubleClick/click/alwaysEdit), Enter/Escape/blur commit.
components.notes: Replaces 6+ inlined click-to-edit patterns in project-overview-sidebar, project-dashboard, projects-overview-dashboard, doc-folder-tree, ColumnHeader (via internal use), widget-grid WidgetShell (planned).

components.name: PermissionMatrix
components.summary: Reusable permission builder with compact preset boxes and searchable module/action rows.
components.notes: Includes QuickRoleSelector for preset role templates. Designed for organization work roles and future MCP/API permission configuration surfaces.

components.name: AiConversationThread
components.summary: Shared AI chat message renderer for full AI mode and the resizable quick AI panel. Handles user/assistant layout, thinking state, live Eve action progress, follow-up actions, suggestions, and plan cards.
components.notes: Presentation-only. Containers own Eve session, persistence, thread history, composer state, and panel sizing.

components.name: SidebarPanelLink
components.summary: Shared Workspace sidebar panel link. Handles active route/query matching, consistent icon/label layout, and optional hover picker content.
components.notes: Extracted from duplicated local PanelLink modules in sidebar domain and inbox panels.

components.name: SidebarProjectedDomainLinks
components.summary: Renders the fixed authorized portion of a contextual domain tree from semantic route, icon, label, and query identifiers.
components.notes: Dynamic Space/resource trees remain owned by their domain panels; this component renders only server-authorized fixed nodes.

components.name: TaskTableView
components.summary: AG Grid-backed task management table using QentrahTable with task-specific density, row placement, and shared task cell editors.
components.notes: Uses @qentrah/ui/qentrah-table renderers/editors and the qentrah-task-table skin. Quick cell editors are anchored non-modal popovers, and the skin keeps semantic row/column separators visible in dark mode. Supports flat mode plus grouped status/priority sections. The canonical TaskWorkspace URL/saved-view codec controls grouping, sorting, density, and AG Grid column order/width/visibility through QentrahTableColumnState.

components.name: TaskBoardView
components.summary: Native ClickUp-style task board. Renders status columns, real task metadata, inline group-aware task creation, and stable drag/drop move events.
components.notes: Native task board with compact status columns, controlled drag/drop, inline creation using real member options and the shared date picker, reusable task tags, persistent group colors, and functional column quick actions. Replaced the SVAR render because exact board UX required local layout control.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Native Shadcn table primitives for semantic, accessible data tables.
components.notes: Use for compact domain tables where AG Grid features such as inline editing, virtualisation, or drag/drop are not required.

components.name: TaskListView
components.summary: ClickUp-style grouped Task list. Shows status sections with table-like rows for name, assignee, due date, priority, and action items.
components.notes: Replaces the previous List tab placeholder.

components.name: CalendarRelationPicker
components.summary: Searchable calendar relationship picker that displays human-readable record names while persisting stable IDs.
components.notes: Uses shared Popover, Input, and Button primitives. Supports people, tasks, documents, and projects without exposing IDs in the UI.

components.name: CalendarEventFormDialog
components.summary: Notion-style calendar composer whose meeting, task, document, reminder, milestone, and focus modes render only the real fields supported by that item type.
components.notes: Uses the shared Shadcn/Base UI primitives and live task, document, and project options. Switching type clears incompatible hidden fields before persistence.

components.name: CalendarGrid
components.summary: Native Qentrah calendar grid with month, week, and day modes; supports press-drag-release time-range selection and real event callbacks.
components.notes: Replaces the SVAR Calendar surface. Week/day time slots open the event form only when a press-drag selection is released.

components.name: CreateResourceDialog
components.summary: Unified Shadcn creation dialog with Task and Document tabs, shared validation, and caller-owned domain mutation callbacks.
components.notes: Keeps creation UI reusable while canonical Task and Document writes remain owned by their domain callers. Additional resource tabs can be added without introducing a second data layer.

components.name: ResourceWorkspaceLayout
components.summary: Route-oriented resource workspace shell with persistent header, count, linked view tabs, configurable actions, toolbar placement, and an optional docked view extension panel.
components.notes: Owns placement only. Domain route layouts provide configuration and view pages provide domain Adapters. Pathname transitions are scoped inside the body seam so the persistent header and tabs never remount or fade. The exported useResourceWorkspaceExtension hook lets the active view dock view-owned UI without moving that logic into the shell. Does not import domain mutations or schemas.

components.name: ProjectManagementTree
components.summary: Stateless hierarchical renderer for an authorized Project-management navigation projection, including Spaces, Projects, documents, Channels, direct messages, counts, and create actions.
components.notes: Rendering-only. Convex projectWorkspace.getProjectManagementTree filters every Space, Project, Document, and Channel before this component receives the payload. Expansion remains UI-only state in the domain adapter.

components.name: ResourceViewMenu
components.summary: Searchable categorized Add View menu driven entirely by a domain-supplied view catalog and callback.
components.notes: Supports popular, more, and embed sections. It does not decide which views a domain permits or how a view is persisted.

components.name: WorkspaceDatePicker
components.summary: Reusable Qentrah start/due date popover with quick presets, month navigation, single-date selection, and optional recurrence action.
components.notes: Caller owns date and recurrence state. Built on the registered Calendar and Popover primitives so tasks, projects, forms, and editors can reuse one date interaction without duplicating domain writes.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: ReUI/Shadcn React DayPicker calendar primitive with Qentrah button variants, single-date and range states, keyboard focus, and locale support.
components.notes: Installed from @reui/c-calendar-27 with pnpm dlx shadcn@latest. Existing Qentrah Button, Card, and Popover primitives were intentionally preserved.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: Base UI scroll-area primitive installed with the ReUI calendar package, with vertical and horizontal scrollbar support.
components.notes: Installed as a dependency of @reui/c-calendar-27.
